title: Adult not breathing — CPR
scenario: Adult is unresponsive and not breathing or only gasping. No signs of life after collapse, no pulse, not moving.
steps: Check for response: tap their shoulders and shout.
Call 911 first — put the phone on speaker so your hands stay free.
Lay the person on their back on a firm surface.
Start chest compressions: place both hands in the center of the chest and push hard and fast, about 2 inches deep, 100 to 120 times per minute.
Let the chest rise fully between pushes. Do not stop.
If you are trained, give 2 rescue breaths after every 30 compressions; if not, continue compressions only.
If an AED is nearby, send someone for it and follow its voice prompts.
Continue until the person breathes, help takes over, or you are physically unable.
do_not: Do not delay compressions to look for a pulse for more than a few seconds.
Do not give anything by mouth.
